title: iOS Flutter button label appears doubled in desc, so --text cannot tap it
symptom: app tap --text returns not_found, but the text is in the tree ('GitHub로 계속하기\nGitHub로 계속하기', i.e. 'Continue with GitHub' twice)
cause: Flutter Semantics labels come out as desc, with the same line repeated twice. Older versions looked only at the text field
fix: Check the element's desc in app tree
Tap with launch_cli.py app tap --desc <text> (the latest version matches desc and doubled labels automatically)
If a button inside a webview cannot be found by name, use --at ratio coordinates
